dedupe_keys.name: observatoire geophysique d arta seismic network fdsn network dj djibouti

description: The International Federation of Digital Seismograph Networks lists network DJ, operated by the Observatoire Géophysique d'Arta (OGA) in Djibouti since 2018. Its entry says the objective is to follow the seismic activity of the Republic of Djibouti and that the network consists of 16 seismic stations, six of them with a three-component sensor. The network has a digital object identifier (10.7914/SN/DJ) for citation, and its waveform data and station metadata are reached through the FDSN web services, the common data access interface for seismic data, with availability taken from the IRIS fedcatalog service. The operator's own website is oga.dj. Access through the FDSN services is free where the data are open; no licence is stated on the FDSN page read, and data availability for this network was not confirmed on the page, which loads it by script. Caveats: the station list, data centre and any embargo were not read, and the network started only in 2018. Coverage is Djibouti. It supports earthquake hazard analysis for the port, rail and energy infrastructure of Djibouti and the Afar region; related records are the CRAAG Algeria seismic network and the GEM global seismic hazard map.
